overview_description.description: S4S Technologies is a food preservation company that invents new food processing machines. It sells the machines to farmers or uses them at its own facility to produce the highest-quality processed food. S4S Technologies works with many partner organizations to create a sustainable supply of processed food products.

product.name: Solar Conduction Dryer

product.name: Village Level Sourcing
product.description: Procurement of fresh produce from farmers through Village Level Collection Centres.

product.name: Farm Gate Processing
product.description: Processing of produce via climate-clean micro-food processing units to produce convenient-to-use products.
